newsitem.title: USA: Boston Properties buys $14.9 mln office bldg.
newsitem.headline: Boston Properties buys $14.9 mln office bldg.

text.p: Boston Properties Inc said Thursday that it recently closed on its acquisition of Newport Office Park, a 169,000-square-foot, 100 percent leased, Class A office building located less than five miles south of Boston in North Quincy, Mass.
Boston Propeties is chaired by Mort Zuckerman, owner of The Daily News, U.S. News and World Report and The Atlantic Monthly.
The property was acquired for about $14.9 million, net of about $6.9 million of indebtedness assumed by the company, Boston Properties said.

As of June 30, 1997, Boston Properties said its portfolio consisted of 11.0 million square feet, including seven properties under development totaling 810,000 square feet, with a total investment of approximately $36 million.
The overall occupancy rate was 98 percent for the second quarter, up from 94 percent at December 31, 1996, the company said.
The occupancy rate was 98 percent for the Class A office buildings and R&D buildings, while the occupancy for the Industrial Buildings was 93 percent.
